title: Construct chronological rank libraries at independent ambient caps and prove the quadratic explicit width-output obstruction
body:
## Exact scoped result
Quantitative rank libraries extend to fixed independent ambient caps; a varying-ambient family shows a quadratic lower bound on explicit output width. Separate proof and finite checks passed. This does not prove a selected full compiler. Credits #7345.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/d622d8c62defa9defeb95741e88b33a120044866/research/ambient-rank-library
